summary: Robustness epic, Tier 1 (CI/CD) — sprint 2026-W26. A GitHub Actions build+test+scan gate on dev. Triaged for conflict-free fan-out: Wave 1 lands the foundational ci.yml (Postgres service container + ./mvnw verify). Wave 2 runs the two issues that both edit ci.yml sequentially (Maven cache, then Trivy) to avoid merge conflicts. Wave 3 runs the two file-independent issues in parallel (Dependabot config, and gh-api branch protection which only needs Wave 1's stable check name). Tier 2/3 deferred to future sprints.

waves.label: Wave 1 — CI core (foundation)
waves.blurb: ci.yml with a postgres:16 service container running ./mvnw -B verify, proven green on a PR to dev. Test DB overridden via TEST_DB_URL/USERNAME/PASSWORD env (see #15 stage-4 note). Everything else extends this file or depends on its check name.

waves.label: Wave 2 — ci.yml extensions (sequential)
waves.blurb: Both edit .github/workflows/ci.yml, so run one at a time to avoid merge conflicts: #16 (Maven cache) then #18 (Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL scan). Each branches off dev after the prior merges.

waves.label: Wave 3 — Independent (parallel)
waves.blurb: #17 (new .github/dependabot.yml) and #19 (enable required-status-check branch protection on dev via gh api) touch neither ci.yml nor each other. #19 depends only on Wave 1's stable check name.
